cells.scene: A weather observer studies a barometer and dark clouds and points to a coming rain icon on a simple forecast board.
A French Alpine city vignette with a riverside town, mountain backdrop and a small spherical cable-car cabin climbing toward a hilltop fort.
A deep broad rocky chasm separates two cliff edges, dark floor far below and one distant bridge giving scale.
A jeweler inspects a tiny internal flaw in a clear gemstone with a magnifying glass, subtle dark inclusion highlighted.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — foretell (v.预言): A weather observer studies a barometer and dark clouds and points to a coming rain icon on a simple forecast board.
TOP RIGHT — Grenoble (n.格里诺布尔): A French Alpine city vignette with a riverside town, mountain backdrop and a small spherical cable-car cabin climbing toward a hilltop fort.
BOTTOM LEFT — chasm (n.断层，裂口，陷坑): A deep broad rocky chasm separates two cliff edges, dark floor far below and one distant bridge giving scale.
BOTTOM RIGHT — flaw (n.小裂缝；缺点，瑕疵): A jeweler inspects a tiny internal flaw in a clear gemstone with a magnifying glass, subtle dark inclusion highlighted.
CROP SAFETY: each scene has 20% white margins inside its own quadrant. Top drawings fully end ABOVE 45% image height. Bottom-row heads, hair, thought bubbles and main objects begin BELOW 58% total image height. Nothing crosses midlines.
review_notes: Reviewed complete contained scenes, recognizability and meaning. Stalagmite grows from floor, waterspout is pressurized water column, boom is sound resonance. Geographic art is illustrative mnemonic.
